Head north from the hotel to the Itabaca Channel, where you’ll board a yacht for South Plaza Island. Just off the eastern tip of Santa Cruz, South Plaza is one of the smallest islands in the archipelago. After an hour and a half at sea, you’ll be greeted by a red-and-green carpet of sesuvium, endemic plants scattered across the island, and the barks of the sea lion families that live here. Turquoise water frames the white sand and volcanic formations along the shore.

The island walk is easy. The trail passes sea lions and Galápagos land iguanas before reaching the highest cliff, where the calls of swallow-tailed gulls ring through the air. Solitary male sea lions that have lost out to rivals competing for mates retreat up the almost vertical rock face. Meanwhile, tropicbirds, blue-footed boobies and frigatebirds glide overhead. Bring binoculars for a closer look at the wildlife. From the highest point, you can watch powerful waves break against the cliffs.

Continue to Punta Carrión, with lunch on board. This is a spot for snorkeling and swimming alongside rays, reef sharks, Galápagos sharks and hundreds of colorful tropical fish.

Return to the hotel. The evening is free.

Transfer to Baltra Airport for the return flight to Guayaquil.
On arrival, meet your driver for the transfer to your hotel. The evening is free.
